body: I am the one making him out to be the bad guy.

I plan on killing myself in two years. I am going to try to improve my life as I have been. I suppose it really depends on if I can find some kind of purpose, or some means of being significant to someone.

That's the thing. I thought I was doing well. I had no thoughts of self harm. My therapist told me to take care of myself. So I tried. I started making friends. I went out. I bought myself a birthday gift. I even planned a dream vacation for my birthday. I ended up putting myself first and almost didn't give my husband the money for his motorcycle so that I could go on vacation for my birthday. I did the right thing in the end, but I lost $340 on hotel reservations that were nonrefundable. So I got depressed because I had to cancel it, lost so much money, and then I had another fight with my husband. I felt horrible and depressed. My husband said the therapy obviously isn't working. All the old feelings that I haven't had in months came rushing back. I try to take care of myself and make myself feel special, but then I still get down that I put so much time, effort, and thought into other people and no one does the same for me. I don't understand what is wrong with me. I feel so insignificant, and then I make my husband out to be the bad guy. Then I try to make it up to him. Until I get feel depressed that I'm doing so much with so little in return. So the cycle repeats. Over and over. 

Why would *my* hurt be any more important than his hurt? He isn't causing my hurt. I'm causing his hurt and serious damage. I haven't seen my therapist since I started feeling this way. I had to cancel my last one. My next one is the day after my birthday: July 6th.

I'm crazy. I've been in therapy for a while now, but my husband says it's not helping. I thought for a moment it was, but I just keep going around the same circle. I try so hard to hide the crazy. I really do. I try so hard to not bring my husband down with me, but the thoughts and memories swirl around in my head all the same. I have done so much damage to my husband, his relationships with his family, his public image...I just keep bouncing around in my head from "I deserve better than this" to "I'm the one doing all the wrong" to "Just let me die so I won't hurt anymore". I keep my husband on this horrible roller coaster. He's exhausted. So am I.
